caption: One 1000 MIPS VM runs the five cloudlets shortest first: C4 (2000 MI) from 0 to 2 s, then C2, C5, C3 and C1, ending at 31 s. Every bar starts where the previous one ends, so the last finish is the makespan.

spec.aria: A single timeline for one 1000 MIPS VM showing five cloudlets back to back in shortest-job-first order: C4 from 0 to 2 s, C2 from 2 to 7 s, C5 from 7 to 13 s, C3 from 13 to 21 s and C1 from 21 to 31 s.
